precision: Offline only: identical checkpoint expert weights widened to FP32; all expert/sampler arithmetic FP32, TF32 disabled. Backbone weights retain native BF16/FP32; prefix KV widened to FP32. Deployment unchanged.
coordinates: Normalized FP32 sampler coordinates; G_k maps post-Euler x_(k+1) to x_10; G9=I.
jacobian_definition: J_D9 = d[x_9 - 0.1*v_9(x_9)]/dx_9, projected10x7 input/output window; other25 action channels held fixed only at input, subsequently free to respond.

shape_fit.method: Nonnegative one-parameter least squares through origin in gain-ratio space; negative noisy slope estimates remain in the data, never clipped; no extra fitted parameter
shape_fit.interpretation: Primary: JVP-derived isotropic squared gains in the offline FP32 expert/sampler. No finite-amplitude window is needed for this fit.

jvp_shape_fit.method: Nonnegative one-parameter least squares through origin in gain-ratio space; negative noisy slope estimates remain in the data, never clipped; no extra fitted parameter
jvp_shape_fit.interpretation: Primary: JVP-derived isotropic squared gains in the offline FP32 expert/sampler. No finite-amplitude window is needed for this fit.

finite_shape_fit.method: Nonnegative one-parameter least squares through origin in gain-ratio space; negative noisy slope estimates remain in the data, never clipped; no extra fitted parameter

norm_comparison.interpretation: The gain law is fitted to isotropic squared gains. RMS(J) is the comparable average-direction norm; spectral norm and trace/d are separately measured and not assumed equal to RMS(J).

finite_amplitude_scope: Paired same-observation, same latent-noise0 forwards. Explicit two-run delta-v=0 floor. Geometric amplitude grid ratio3. Qualification requires signal>10x floor and <20% change in energy-ratio slope over each3x amplitude increment; all qualifying pairs and per-observation counts reported. Fit each observation separately, then average slopes with equal observation weight, matching primary mean JVP squared gains. Bootstrap confidence intervals condition on the selected window.

native_bf16_pilot.interpretation: Preserved separately; no general claim that small perturbations are unmeasurable. Superseded by the authorized FP32 paired experiment for the primary theory test.

original_weight_noise_D3.interpretation: Original weight-noise D3 retained unchanged. Steps0..7 remain censored lower bounds. Only step8 is uncensored in the0..8 fit range; shape R2 is not identifiable and no lower bound is a measured value.
